prompt: Robe-man speaks weird words. Makes my head itch. Can I smash his shiny stick?

dialogues.text: Yeah. He smells like old blood and bad breath. My hammer fix him.
It glows purple. Purple is the color of tricksy magic. I hate magic.

prompt: Found a shiny blue bug. It look like it crying. Do I eat it, or make it my lieutenant?

dialogues.text: It made Gribble spit up his stomach. Very strong bug.
It got tiny pincers. It bit my nose. It has the spirit of an Orc!

prompt: Master! The metal-man keeps crying on our mushrooms! His sad-water makes the caps too salty!

dialogues.text: Yes! He sits in the dirt and sighs really loud! It ruins our appetites!
But we likes this patch of dirt! It's extra damp!

prompt: We finds a baby dragon! It thinks Snivel is its mommy! Do I feeds it my brother, or tries to ride it?!

dialogues.text: It only listens when I screams in terror!
Goblins, mostly. It has very expensive taste!

prompt: Overlord. The coin-peddler sold my elites dull blades. Give me permission to mount his head on a pike.

dialogues.text: He claims it is a 'subscription service' to keep them sharp. I will subscribe my axe to his neck.
They couldn't cut through warm butter, let alone a Paladin's breastplate.

prompt: A surface general challenges me to a game of 'chess' for control of the valley. Is it cowardly to simply eat the board?

dialogues.text: I know the little horses taste like cedar wood.
Then my head becomes his trophy. I prefer eating the horses.

prompt: Da big tentacle monster keeps stealing da boyz' boots! Say it need 'vessels'! Tell it to stop!

dialogues.text: Yeah! Da squiggly one! It makes da boots walk around by demselves! Very spooky!
Yeah, but they're full of slime and existential dread!

prompt: Greenfang feel funny inside. Like... sad? But angry? A humie called it 'heart-break'. How I punch it?

dialogues.text: I dropped my favorite smashing-rock in da lava. It melted, Boss. It melted.
I tried thinking about war, but the rock used to be there for the war too!

prompt: Boss... the little green runts are using my old war-banners as diapers. Just let me cull a few hundred of them.

dialogues.text: That banner survived the Siege of Blood-Creek. Now it smells like sour milk.
It’s beyond washing, Boss. The stain is a war crime.

prompt: I captured my old nemesis. A paladin. But he's old now. Bald. Bad knees. Do I kill him, or just let him go?

dialogues.text: He once cut my eye out. Now he's complaining about the draft in the cell.
Killing him now feels like putting down a sick dog. There is no glory.

prompt: Overlord. That rusted imbecile Kargoth keeps using my sacrificial chalice to drink his... 'grog'. Have him flogged.

dialogues.text: It neutralizes the eldritch energies! And leaves a sticky residue!
Something that smells like fermented horse and battery acid.

prompt: I have accidentally cursed myself to only speak in rhymes. Shall I cut out my tongue, or embrace the poetry?

dialogues.text: The darkness calls, the shadows creep, I stubbed my toe and want to weep.
To break the hex and speak quite plain, I must inflict a world of pain.

prompt: My Lord. That brute Greenfang is using my family's ancestral shield as a sled. It strips the last vestiges of my dignity.

dialogues.text: Tragically, yes. The aerodynamics of the crest are quite unparalleled.
He weighs more than a small siege engine. I would simply be flattened.

prompt: My Lord. I occasionally remember the taste of fresh strawberries. Should I try to eat one, though I lack a stomach?

dialogues.text: It will simply fall through my ribcage onto the floor. A stark metaphor.
I shall send a dozen goblins to the surface. Most will not return.

prompt: Overlord! That hulking Warlord refuses to pay my 'convenience fee' on sharpening stones! Back me up!

dialogues.text: A mere 400% markup! Standard supply and demand in a dungeon!
My profit margins say yes! My survival instincts say... maybe.

prompt: Friend, pal! I can technically sell the same soul twice. Is the double-profit worth the eternal damnation?

dialogues.text: Legally? A goblin named 'Toes.' He just stamped his thumb.
A very confused demon and a surface-world hedge fund manager.

prompt: OVERLORD. THE TINY COIN-MAN ATTEMPTS TO SELL ME 'VOID INSURANCE'. CAN I UNMAKE HIS BLOODLINE?

dialogues.text: YES. HE HANDED ME A PAMPHLET. IT TASTED LIKE PURE ARROGANCE.
LOSS OF LIMBS AND ACCIDENTAL COSMIC ERASURE. IT IS RIDICULOUS.

prompt: OVERLORD. I HAVE DEVELOPED A CONCEPT CALLED 'EMPATHY'. DO I SPREAD IT TO THE SWARM, OR CONSUME IT?

dialogues.text: LIKE CARING ABOUT THE GOBLINS. IT IS THE MOST HORRIFIC SENSATION.
THEY WILL STOP STABBING EACH OTHER. PRODUCTIVITY WILL PLUMMET.
